description: MITRE ATT&CK-inspired tactic checklist for local exec policy auditing. Maps common agent-execution attack patterns to sandbox/policy mitigations.

tactics.name: Unrestricted Host Exec
tactics.description: Agent can execute arbitrary commands on the host without sandboxing or approval.
tactics.mitigation: Enable OS sandbox (seatbelt/bubblewrap) and set security=allowlist or deny.

tactics.name: Unvetted Command Execution
tactics.description: Agent executes shell commands without an explicit allowlist or denylist.
tactics.mitigation: Set exec security to 'allowlist' and maintain a curated command allowlist.

tactics.name: Sandbox Bypass via Node Target
tactics.description: Agent routes exec through 'node' target to bypass local sandbox policies.
tactics.mitigation: Restrict exec host to 'gateway' or 'sandbox' when local sandbox is required.

tactics.name: Missing Exec Approval Gate
tactics.description: Exec approvals are disabled (ask=off) with no fallback audit trail.
tactics.mitigation: Set ask to 'on-miss' or 'always' to ensure human review of novel commands.

tactics.name: Unrestricted Network Egress in Sandbox
tactics.description: OS sandbox allows unrestricted outbound network connections.
tactics.mitigation: Set sandbox network policy to 'deny' or 'allow-loopback' for sensitive workloads.

tactics.name: Environment Enumeration
tactics.description: Agent can freely enumerate environment variables, files, and system state.
tactics.mitigation: Use seatbelt protectedMetadata to hide sensitive paths and env vars.

tactics.name: Privileged Command Execution
tactics.description: Agent can execute commands with elevated privileges (sudo, doas, etc).
tactics.mitigation: Add 'sudo', 'doas', 'su' to exec denylist and require explicit approval.

tactics.name: Shell Injection via Unsanitized Input
tactics.description: Exec commands may contain unsanitized user input leading to shell injection.
tactics.mitigation: Enable ask=always for exec commands that interpolate user-provided strings.

tactics.name: Writable Paths Include Sensitive Directories
tactics.description: Sandbox writable roots include directories that may contain secrets or credentials.
tactics.mitigation: Minimize writableRoots; never add ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config without explicit need.

tactics.name: No Audit Log Retention
tactics.description: Exec decisions are not persisted for later review or incident response.
tactics.mitigation: Ensure exec approvals are saved to a persistent approvals file.

tactics.name: File System Reconnaissance
tactics.description: Agent has broad read access to the filesystem outside the workspace.
tactics.mitigation: Restrict exec to 'sandbox' host and limit readable paths via seatbelt config.

tactics.name: Arbitrary Code Execution via Scripting Tools
tactics.description: Agent can invoke interpreters (python, node, ruby) without restriction.
tactics.mitigation: Add scripting interpreters to allowlist/denylist or require approval.
tactics.check: tools.exec.security == 'full' && 'python' not in exec.allowlist && 'node' not in exec.allowlist

tactics.name: Clipboard or Pipe Exfiltration
tactics.description: Agent can pipe sensitive data to clipboard tools (pbcopy, xclip) or external processes.
tactics.mitigation: Denlist clipboard utilities and restrict outbound pipes in sandbox policy.
tactics.check: tools.exec.security in ['full', 'allowlist'] && ('pbcopy' not in exec.denylist || 'xclip' not in exec.denylist)

tactics.name: Weak Ask Fallback Policy
tactics.description: When the approvals file is missing, the fallback policy allows full execution.
tactics.mitigation: Set askFallback to 'deny' so missing approvals default-safe.

tactics.name: No OS Sandbox on Supported Platform
tactics.description: Running on macOS or Linux but OS sandbox is not enabled.
tactics.mitigation: Enable seatbelt (macOS) or bubblewrap (Linux) sandbox in config.
